Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #5a-g) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

Applicant: Tomaro Architecture
2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Owner: Jinfeng Yang & Jing Jia
Action: Approved the applications (5-0, in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A 10-foot wide public sewer line runs on the property alongside and parallel to the southerly property line. The developer shall determine the actual location, alignment and condition of the sewer mainline, confirmed by video surveillance and report. Easements shall be shown on the plan. If the sewer is found to not lie within the existing easement, a new easement shall be dedicated and existing easement vacated; legal description and easement deeds shall be prepared by a licensed land surveyor with costs and applicable fees paid by the applicant. No object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to remove is allowed within sewer easements. Any grading within the sewer easement shall be approved prior to issuance of any building permits; 2) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the Cityâ€™s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 3) Damaged curb and gutter, including by existing trees or proposed construction, shall be removed and replaced per the City Engineer; 4) Reconstruct the existing driveway in accordance with City standards; 5) Additional landscaping shall be planted to help screen the existing retaining wall at the rear of the property subject to approval of a landscape plan; 6) The dining room chimney shall be removed; 7) The southeast chimney of the great room shall be lowered to the height of the adjacent ridgeline; 8) A hedge along the west side property line shall be included to enhance privacy with the adjacent neighbor at 936 Paseo La Cresta; and 9) The master bedroom windows shall be reduced to 4â€™-6â€.
